title: 새해 소원과 목표: 무엇을 빌고, 무엇을 결심했어요?
objective: By the end, you can use words like 소원, 빌다, 이루어지다 and 목표 in short sentences about your wishes and New Year's plans.
summary: Learn ten words for talking about wishes, New Year's goals, and the effort it takes to reach them.

task.title: Use the new words
task.line: Read each item, then choose, fill in, fix, or arrange the Korean words as the instruction says.

words.meaning: a wish; something you hope for deeply
words.example: 제 소원은 부모님이 오래 건강하신 거예요.
words.exampleMeaning: My wish is for my parents to stay healthy for a long time.

words.meaning: to make a wish; to pray for (something)
words.exampleMeaning: I made a wish while looking at the full moon.

words.meaning: to come true (a wish or dream)
words.exampleMeaning: The dream I had hoped for so long finally came true.
On New Year's Day, I went to see the sunrise.

words.meaning: a goal you plan and work toward
words.exampleMeaning: If your goal is too high, you get worn out quickly.
On January 1st, I made my plans for this year.

words.meaning: to decide firmly; to make up your mind (often with -기로)
words.exampleMeaning: I made up my mind to quit smoking starting this year.

words.meaning: to work hard; to make an effort
words.exampleMeaning: I'm putting in effort every day to pass the exam.
Even if it's hard, don't give up halfway.

words.meaning: to hope; to wish (for someone or something). The standard polite form is 바라요, not 바래요.
words.exampleMeaning: I hope everyone is happy in the new year.

exercises: Choose the right word: 동생이 가고 싶던 대학교에 합격해서 꿈이 (빌었어요 / 이루어졌어요).
Fill in the blank with the past form of 빌다: 어제 절에 가서 가족의 건강을 ____.
Is each one a 소원 (a hope you can't fully control) or a 목표 (something you plan and work for)? ① 6월까지 매일 운동해서 5킬로그램 빼기 ② 가족이 모두 아프지 않고 건강하기
Fill in each blank with 세웠어요, 포기했어요, or 노력했어요: ① 너무 바빠서 결국 운동을 ____. ② 여행 가기 전에 꼼꼼하게 계획을 ____. ③ 대회에서 이기려고 매일 밤늦게까지 ____.
Find and fix the one wrong word: 새해에는 좋은 일만 있기를 바래요.
Put the words in order to make one sentence: 결심했어요 / 새해에는 / 일찍 일어나기로
answers: ① 포기했어요 ② 세웠어요 ③ 노력했어요
